channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock closes Sunday for $3 million renovation project
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock closes July 6 for a year-long $3 million renovation that will nearly double slip capacity from 18 to 44.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to win 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was one of just 10 communities nationwide to receive the prestigious National Civic League honor. Mayor Douglas Lawson called the recognition a proud moment for the city.

item.title: Juno Beach Town Council to decide on fence replacement at JB-7 beach access after condo complaints
item.description: Colony Condos residents say beachgoers are cutting through private property at the JB-7 public walkway since the town removed a fence in 2023. The council will take up the issue during budget discussions on July 15.

item.title: Martin County Maritime Response Unit deploys teams for Fourth of July boating weekend
item.description: Lt. Brett Harry said his team will have two boats with medics on standby in north and south Martin County to respond to boating emergencies. Hundreds of boaters are expected on the water this weekend.

item.title: S.D. Spady Elementary in Delray Beach jumps from C to A rating as Palm Beach County schools earn third consecutive A
item.description: The School District of Palm Beach County earned an A rating from the state for the third consecutive year. S.D. Spady Elementary made a dramatic leap from a C rating last year to an A this year.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation transforms Fort Pierce into artistic destination with global residency program
item.description: The nonprofit organization preserves the Crain Estate and connects local and international artists through its residency program. Visitors can take guided tours every Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

item.title: Record Fourth of July travel brings heavy traffic and rain to Florida Turnpike south of Orlando
item.description: AAA estimates 72.2 million Americans will have traveled at least 50 miles from home between June 27 and July 5, marking an all-time high. Of that number, 61.4 million are making the trip by car.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk comments
item.description: The Martin County School Board is challenging a judge's recommendation to reinstate Matt Theobald, a social studies teacher at Spectrum Academy since 2009, who was suspended following social media comments about Charlie Kirk. item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League. The city was the only Florida community selected for the honor this year.

item.title: Port St. Lucie approves land transfer for new Florida Turnpike interchange at Midway Road
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation for a partial interchange on Florida's Turnpike. The city says the interchange will accommodate growth over the next 20 to 50 years.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation offers tours, classes at historic Crain Estate in Fort Pierce
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation in Fort Pierce preserves the legacy of Jaxson and Mary Crain, who once owned the property. Visitors can take guided tours of the lush gardens and vibrant architecture every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

item.title: St. Lucie County marine deputies rescue two after boat sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: Two boaters are safe after their vessel sank in the Intracoastal Waterway on Wednesday. The St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office Marine Unit responded to reports of a small motorized boat taking on water and becoming submerged on July 1.

item.title: Hobe Sound community fundraises for man who lost fiance in deadly home fire
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help her fiance Mark rebuild after the flames destroyed many belongings.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs up 4% this year, ground beef and buns see biggest increases
item.description: A Fourth of July meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey. Ground beef is up 5.5% and buns are up 7.7%.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock closes Monday for $3 million renovation, doubling boat slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a $3 million renovation project expected to be complete by next Fourth of July. item.title: Martin County Maritime Response Unit deploys two boats for Fourth of July weekend
item.description: Martin County Maritime Response Unit has two boats with medics on standby in the north and south as hundreds of boaters take to the waterways for Fourth of July weekend.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman dies in Monday house fire as community raises funds for fiance
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help her fiance Mark rebuild.

item.title: Record Fourth of July travel brings heavy traffic to Florida Turnpike near Orlando
item.description: AAA estimates 72.2 million Americans will have traveled at least 50 miles from home between Saturday, June 27 and Sunday, July 5, with 61.4 million traveling by car.

item.title: Breast cancer patient speaks out after insurance denies reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, had her insurance deny coverage for breast reconstruction surgery less than 24 hours before it was scheduled, but her surgeon found a way to complete the procedure.

item.title: Saint Andrew's Scots football targets state title after 10-2 season and district championship
item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots football program is targeting a state title in the 2026 fall season after finishing last year with a 10-2 record and a district championship. item.description: Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach is offering educational and interactive programs during peak sea turtle nesting season through September. item.title: North Palm Beach celebrates Fourth of July with fireworks and America 250 events
item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors celebrated Independence Day with a full day of family-friendly activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse on July 4.

item.title: Florida state parks waive admission fees for America's 250th anniversary weekend
item.description: The Florida Department of Environmental Protection offered free admission to state parks from Friday through Sunday to celebrate Independence Day and the nation's semiquincentennial.

item.title: DeSantis signs $117.6 billion state budget with $810 million in vetoes
item.description: Gov. Ron DeSantis signed a $117.6 billion state budget this week, marking the fourth consecutive year of declining state spending. item.title: Southwest Florida celebrates America's 250th with fireworks, parades and drone shows
item.description: Communities from Sarasota to Fort Myers Beach marked the semiquincentennial with waterfront celebrations, Fourth of July parades and fireworks displays across the region.

item.title: Marion County stages four synchronized fireworks displays for America's 250th
item.description: Ocala and Marion County celebrated the semiquincentennial with four synchronized fireworks shows, parades and free aquatic activities across the county.

item.title: North Port celebrates Independence Day at CoolToday Park
item.description: North Port's Freedom Festival at CoolToday Park featured patriotic entertainment, live music and fireworks to commemorate the nation's 250th anniversary.

item.title: Fort Myers hosts concert and combined fireworks-drone show for America's 250th
item.description: Downtown Fort Myers celebrated the semiquincentennial with a free concert by Deb The Dynamics and a combined fireworks and drone show at the Caloosa Sound Amphitheater.

item.title: Longboat Key hosts Freedom Fest with shortest parade, park rededication
item.description: Longboat Key celebrated Independence Day with the Shortest Parade in America, a rededication of Bicentennial Park and a hot dog costume contest.

item.title: Record Fourth of July travel brings heavy traffic and rain to Florida roads
item.description: A record number of Americans traveled this Fourth of July weekend, with South Florida drivers experiencing heavy traffic compounded by rain.

item.title: Firefighters extinguish blaze at abandoned building in Jensen Beach
item.description: Fire agencies responded to a structure fire at an abandoned building in Jensen Beach on Saturday.

item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is establishing Fort Pierce as an artistic destination by preserving the historic Crain Estate in the Peacock Arts District. item.title: Fort Pierce waterfront hosts 16th annual boat parade
item.description: The Fort Pierce waterfront turned red, white and blue for the 16th annual boat parade on July 4.

item.title: Fort Pierce woman recognized for supporting little free libraries
item.description: A Fort Pierce woman was recognized for her support of little free libraries in the community.

item.title: Costco plans first Treasure Coast store in Port St. Lucie
item.description: Costco is planning its first Treasure Coast location in Port St. Lucie.

item.description: The Legacy Lions Football team in Port St. Lucie had its standings updated.
